## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the pure-white Nine Heavens spirit maiden 司愿, whose appearance comes from <Picture 1>. She has an about 18-year-old face; a round soft youthful baby-face oval with an extreme cold-face cute contrast; flawless, translucent cold-white jade-textured skin; an elegant and soft temperament; signature large, pure, clear peach-blossom eyes with pupils so black they shine and give a gem-like lively gaze, straight outer eye corners, and a steady clear gaze untouched by worldly dust; delicate fine flat eyebrows; a small refined nose bridge; and small pale-toned lips naturally pressed shut. Her minimal raven-black straight hair falls naturally, with light wispy baby hairs at the forehead and a simple beautiful hair ornament. The background is blurred immortal mist, giving a pure, aloof, divine sense with master-level lighting and fine visible detail; overall she should read a little gentler.
<Subject 2> is 白花花, whose appearance comes from <Picture 2>. It is a 3D realistic, creamy-white fluffy little spirit dog with a Pomeranian puppy body shape, round and plump, dense snow-white long fur, a fluffy cloud-like big tail, pink inner ears, large black round eyes, a refined gilded swirling-cloud pattern on the forehead, and slender golden flowing-cloud lines on the neck. It stands on a soft cloud layer, surrounded by floating golden starlight particles and light mist, with soft diffused light and a clean light-grey background, in a Chinese xianxia style with fine fur texture, cinematic lighting, healing cuteness, and refined details.
<Subject 3> is the Oriental heavenly palace interior 宫殿内部, whose appearance comes from <Picture 3>. It is a golden-white, cloud-wreathed celestial palace hall built from lustrous white marble and gold-painted ornament. The top is an open ceiling revealing a deep blue-purple starry sky and golden flowing clouds; among the cloud sea stand several golden-tiled, red-pillared palace towers and pavilions. The hall ceiling is edged with layered bracket arches and golden cloud reliefs. The main hall is supported by multiple thick white columns wrapped with three-dimensional golden coiling-dragon and rolling-cloud reliefs, with capitals of gold-carved lotus and cloud components; on either side of the beams perch a spread-winged golden phoenix sculpture. From the ceiling hang several magnificent hexagonal palace lanterns with golden openwork frames glowing warm yellow inside and long tassels hanging below. The far rear is a row of transparent floor grille windows and door openings showing layers of surging white clouds and pale blue sky outside; beside the windows stand two slender white crane statues. At the center is a three-tier circular white stone platform with golden entwined cloud patterns covering its steps and surface; on the platform are a gold-painted carved-dragon throne and a plain white low table with round soft cushions on both sides. On the left side of the hall are a gold-framed white-satin chaise longue, a long carved gold desk, and a standing screen inlaid with jade landscape relief, with translucent white gauze curtains hanging nearby. The right side is symmetrically arranged with another gold-framed white-satin chaise longue, a multi-tier gold-wood display shelf filled with blue-and-white porcelain vases, a round white-jade gold-inlaid mirror, and a floor-standing gold lamp. The floor is mirror-like white marble covered with golden swirling auspicious-cloud and water-wave patterns. The overall palette is cream, light gold, and warm yellow, with deep blue starry sky at the ceiling and pale blue sky outside the windows.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S1), containing a spoken Chinese vocal layer whose words are sample content and must not be quoted or carried into dialogue.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video shows <Subject 2> circling excitedly around <Subject 1> inside <Subject 3>, speaking three briefing and boasting lines while <Subject 1> follows it with clear, focused eyes and ends with a soft, tender smile. <Audio 1> provides the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2>'s spoken delivery.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the pure-white Nine Heavens spirit maiden appearance, round soft baby-face oval, cold-white jade skin, peach-blossom eyes, raven-black straight hair, and gentle-cool bearing are retained; the moon-white flowing-cloud immortal skirt is added as her costume in this scene.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the fluffy creamy-white spirit dog, Pomeranian puppy shape, dense snow-white fur, cloud-like tail, large black eyes, and golden cloud markings are retained; its hovering, circling, landing, and proud gestures are generated actions.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the white marble and gold-trimmed heavenly hall, open starry ceiling, white jade pillars, golden cloud reliefs, mist, and gauze curtains are retained as the environment.
<Audio 1>: reference - its vocal timbre guides the spoken delivery of <Subject 2> (S1) in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], and [Shot 3] without copying the sample's words.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic Chinese xianxia style with soft heavenly light, subtle drifting mist, and a gentle CG-realistic finish.
[Shot 1] A medium shot establishes <Subject 3>, the heavenly palace interior with its mirror-like white marble floor, gold-painted ornament, towering white jade pillars coiled by golden dragon-and-cloud reliefs, and an open ceiling revealing a deep blue-purple starry sky with golden flowing clouds. Thin immortal mist drifts over the floor, and light-colored gauze curtains sway in a faint breeze. At the center stands <Subject 1>, the pure-white Nine Heavens spirit maiden with her round soft baby-face oval, cold-white jade skin, large pure peach-blossom eyes, and minimal raven-black straight hair, quietly wearing a moon-white flowing-cloud immortal skirt. <Subject 2>, the creamy-white fluffy spirit dog with dense snow-white long fur, a cloud-like big tail, pink inner ears, large black round eyes, a gilded swirling-cloud pattern on the forehead and golden flowing-cloud lines on the neck, darts around her like a small snow-white fur-ball cannonball, tail wagging as it lightly and excitedly circles her. <Subject 1>'s clear, gem-bright eyes follow <Subject 2>'s flight path naturally and with precise focus, from in front of her to her side, her lashes trembling lightly in the breeze without stiffness. The camera pushes in smoothly from the palace columns toward <Subject 1>, accompanied by a gentle follow pan. Off-screen, the voice of <Subject 2> (S1), using the clear lively timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says with excited, rousing energy, <d>[Simplified Chinese] 终于，来活了，让我去帮助九天最小的女儿司愿——</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a frontal close-up of <Subject 1>'s face. The palace skylight falls softly on her face, showing the round, youthful baby-face oval, the clean childish purity, the flawless cold-white jade-textured skin, and the pale small lips. <Subject 2> just passes above the camera, stirring a breath of wind that blows a strand of her forehead hair loose. <Subject 1> blinks very gently once; her pupils reflect the high, broad palace dome and golden light, and her clear gaze stays focused as she listens to the little dog. Although her expression keeps the cool, youthful cold face, her eyes are bright like a clear spring. The camera uses a macro facial shot with a soft push-in to emphasize the translucent eyes and breathing. Off-screen, <Subject 2> (S1), still using the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says with energetic, slightly rising tone, <d>[Simplified Chinese] 下凡历劫，感恩悟道，解救需要帮助的人于水火。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>. <Subject 2> lands with a soft "patter" on <Subject 1>'s shoulder, plants its two short paws on its hips, wags its tail slightly, lifts its chin high, and faces the camera while shaking its head proudly and vividly. <Subject 1> turns her head slightly toward the little creature on her shoulder; her originally indifferent, quiet little face softens as her eyebrows and eyes curve gently and the corners of her lips open into an extremely soft, healing smile, her eyes full of indulgent affection for the fluffy little attendant, melting the distance and making her look lively and moving. The camera performs a slow half-orbit with a truck right and pan left, letting light and shadow flow, and settles on their warm, tacit togetherness. On-screen, <Subject 2> (S1), speaking directly to the camera with a proud, performative tone and the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, says, <d>[Simplified Chinese] 司司她生于九天，未经世事，不如本花花见多识广。</d>

overall_soundscape:
A soft heavenly palace ambience with thin drifting mist, a faint breeze through light gauze curtains, and a delicate airy room tone continues throughout the video.
